params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: search_semantics
params.description: How to interpret the search input.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to items published after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to items published before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to items modified after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to items modified before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: status
params.description: Limit result set to items assigned one or more statuses. Anonymous callers may only request `publish`.

params.name: author
params.description: Limit result set to pages assigned to specific authors.

params.name: author_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes pages assigned to specific authors.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to items with particular parent IDs.

params.name: parent_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to all items except those of a particular parent ID.

params.name: menu_order
params.description: Limit result set to posts with a specific menu_order value.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by post attribute.

items.docs: Lists published pages. On this deployment the collection is the 29-page corporate site — About, Our Story, Our Values, Our Team (Leadership, Founders, Board of Directors, Senior Advisors, BTX Crew), Our Approach (Platform, Publications), Science, Program, Partners, Patients, Careers, Newsroom, Press Releases, Company News, Podcast, Multimedia Library, Contact, Privacy and Terms.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: password
params.description: The password for the page if it is password protected.

items.docs: Retrieves one published corporate page by its numeric ID.
